state:
**Goal `path-literals-follow-up`: Stage 3 is under way.** Stages 1 and 2 are on disk, and Stage 1's floor is goal `plain-comments`'s list.

ADR 0245 is on disk (`docs/decisions/0245.md`), and `rule:programs/path-literals-resolve-from-their-file` and `rule:config/a-relative-path-resolves-against-the-file-it-is-written-in` already state the whole Stage 3 behaviour.

On disk now: `[[schedule]] script` and `[log] handler` are joined to their file's folder while the configuration is read (`nvs_config::schedule::anchor`, `nvs_config::log::anchor`). `nvs_runtime::script::resolve` refuses a relative path with `capability::relative`'s message, as `ResolveError::Denied`, before the grant. `Core\Queue::push`'s script is `CoreTy::Path(Qual::Sink)`, and the native throws a `RuntimeError` for a relative script before it reads anything else. A row already stored relative is refused by the worker's resolve and dead-lettered (ADR 0245 rejects rewriting it).

Green: the `nvs-types` check (`crates/nvs-types/tests/paths.rs`) and the `nvs-stdlib` check (`queue::tests` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs`, one of them a real push into shared in-memory SQLite). The `nvs-cli` live tests that asserted "`jobs/work.nvs` threw" now match on the file name alone, because the worker names the absolute path.

Open in Stage 3: the `nvs-cli` pair below. Stages 4 to 7 are not started.

next.title: scripts start at their file
next.note: one file set, the live `nvs serve` tests: `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs`.

items.text: **The `nvs-cli` pair** (`rule:config/a-relative-path-resolves-against-the-file-it-is-written-in`, ADR 0245 § 1) — `a_schedule_script_beside_the_configuration_runs_from_any_working_directory` and `a_log_handler_beside_the_configuration_runs_from_any_working_directory`: start the server with its working directory somewhere other than the configuration's folder (`crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs:360` is where `Server` sets `current_dir`), write the script and the handler relative in `nvs.toml` beside them, and assert each one runs. `scheduling` and `MINUTELY` at `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs:1050` are the schedule fixture; a fire waits for the next whole minute.

**Stage 4: `Core\Path::fromCwd` returns a string without `tainted`** — the next stage's `nvs-stdlib` check `from_cwd_returns_a_string_without_tainted` and its `.nvst` case; `fromCwd`'s row is in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/path.rs:1`.

backlog: Stage 5 (`thisFile`, `thisDir`), Stage 6 (`'X' as class<T>`) and Stage 7 (perf records) — `docs/agent/goals/path-literals-follow-up.md`.
